1: // Simple Meteor Dodge game
2: // Canvas element with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return; // canvas must exist
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // Player ship
11:   const ship = {
12:     w: 40,
13:     h: 20,
14:     x: width / 2 - 20,
15:     y: height - 30,
16:     speed: 5,
17:     moveLeft: false,
18:     moveRight: false,
19:     shield: false,
20:     shieldTimer: 0,
21:     draw() {
22:       ctx.fillStyle = this.shield ? 'cyan' : 'white';
23:       ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h);
24:     },
25:     update() {
26:       if (this.moveLeft) this.x = Math.max(0, this.x - this.speed);
27:       if (this.moveRight) this.x = Math.min(width - this.w, this.x + this.speed);
28:       if (this.shield) {
29:         this.shieldTimer -= delta;
30:         if (this.shieldTimer <= 0) this.shield = false;
31:       }
32:     }
33:   };
34: 
35:   // Meteors
36:   const meteors = [];
37:   let meteorSpawnTimer = 0;
38:   let meteorSpeed = 2;
39:   const spawnMeteor = () => {
40:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
41:     meteors.push({
42:       x: Math.random() * (width - size),
43:       y: -size,
44:       w: size,
45:       h: size,
46:       speed: meteorSpeed + Math.random()
47:     });
48:   };
49: 
50:   // Power‑ups (shield only for brevity)
51:   const powerUps = [];
52:   let powerUpTimer = 0;
53:   const spawnPowerUp = () => {
54:     const size = 20;
55:     powerUps.push({
56:       x: Math.random() * (width - size),
57:       y: -size,
58:       w: size,
59:       h: size,
60:       speed: 1.5,
61:       type: 'shield'
62:     });
63:   };
64: 
65:   // Timer (lose condition after 60 seconds)
66:   let gameTime = 60; // seconds
67:   let timer = gameTime;
68:   const timerBarHeight = 5;
69: 
70:   // Input handling
71:   document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
72:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') ship.moveLeft = true;
73:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') ship.moveRight = true;
74:   });
75:   document.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
76:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') ship.moveLeft = false;
77:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') ship.moveRight = false;
78:   });
79: 
80:   let last = performance.now();
81:   let delta = 0;
82:   let gameOver = false;
83: 
84:   const loop = () => {
85:     const now = performance.now();
86:     delta = (now - last) / 1000; // seconds
87:     last = now;
88:     if (gameOver) return;
89: 
90:     // Update timer
91:     timer -= delta;
92:     if (timer <= 0) {
93:       endGame('Time up!');
94:       return;
95:     }
96: 
97:     // Clear
98:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
99: 
100:     // Update ship
101:     ship.update();
102:     ship.draw();
103: 
104:     // Spawn meteors
105:     meteorSpawnTimer -= delta;
106:     if (meteorSpawnTimer <= 0) {
107:       spawnMeteor();
108:       meteorSpawnTimer = Math.max(0.2, 1.5 - timer / gameTime); // faster over time
109:     }
110: 
111:     // Update meteors
112:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
113:       const m = meteors[i];
114:       m.y += m.speed;
115:       ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
116:       ctx.beginPath();
117:       ctx.arc(m.x + m.w / 2, m.y + m.h / 2, m.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
118:       ctx.fill();
119:       // collision
120:       if (!ship.shield && rectIntersect(ship, m)) {
121:         endGame('Hit by meteor');
122:         return;
123:       }
124:       if (m.y > height) meteors.splice(i, 1);
125:     }
126: 
127:     // Power‑up logic
128:     powerUpTimer -= delta;
129:     if (powerUpTimer <= 0) {
130:       spawnPowerUp();
131:       powerUpTimer = 15 + Math.random() * 10;
132:     }
133:     for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
134:       const p = powerUps[i];
135:       p.y += p.speed;
136:       ctx.fillStyle = 'gold';
137:       ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h);
138:       if (rectIntersect(ship, p)) {
139:         if (p.type === 'shield') {
140:           ship.shield = true;
141:           ship.shieldTimer = 5; // seconds
142:         }
143:         powerUps.splice(i, 1);
144:       } else if (p.y > height) powerUps.splice(i, 1);
145:     }
146: 
147:     // Increase meteor speed gradually
148:     meteorSpeed += delta * 0.02;
149: 
150:     // Draw timer bar
151:     ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
152:     ctx.fillRect(0, height - timerBarHeight, (timer / gameTime) * width, timerBarHeight);
153: 
154:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
155:   };
156: 
157:   const rectIntersect = (a, b) => {
158:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
159:   };
160: 
161:   const endGame = msg => {
162:     gameOver = true;
163:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
164:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
165:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
166:     ctx.font = '30px Arial';
167:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
168:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2 - 20);
169:     ctx.fillText(msg, width / 2, height / 2 + 20);
170:   };
171: 
172:   // Start loop
173:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
174: })();
